Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in the amount of P 200,000.00 which has been allocated by a particular SARO, whether obligated or not, for the purchase of one (l) unit multicab, there being no Notice of Cash Allocation (NCA) at the time the SC Decision is promulgated, is covered by the permanent injunction.
